before: Mean paired ratios average $t_{i,\rm fresh}/t_{i,m}$; total ratios divide summed times. P3's three large gains raise its certificate means above one while total ratios remain below one. Both certificates lose in 174/175 P2 trials and 92/95 P3 trials. In P3's $r=1$ panel, seeds 0, 1, and 4 benefit, while 2 and 3 fall back; all five $r=10$ seeds fall back. The successful basic ratios range from 14.455 to 18.480, but the two losses are 0.882 and 0.900. Every pilot seed and comparable end-to-end ratio is reported in \cref{tab:pilot-compact}; five seeds cannot establish reliability or a universal deletion threshold.
after: Mean paired ratios average $t_{i,\rm fresh}/t_{i,m}$; total ratios divide summed times. Direct wins algorithm time in 173/175 P2 and 80/95 P3 trials. P2 certificates slightly reduce total algorithm time but slightly increase total E2E time. P3 certificate means exceed one while total ratios remain below one; Basic/Runner-up lose 74/95 and 76/95 algorithm comparisons. In the $r=1$ panel, seeds 0, 1, and 4 retain assignments; their Basic ratios span 14.438--17.331. Seeds 2/3 fall back yet have ratios 1.145/1.151. All five $r=10$ seeds also fall back and favor replay in these measurements. Every pilot algorithm/E2E ratio is in \cref{tab:pilot-compact}; five seeds cannot establish reliability or a universal deletion threshold.

before: Across the evaluated trials, certification usually adds elapsed time.
after: Direct replay wins most timed comparisons; certificate gains depend on the panel and timing boundary.

before: The frozen FTF-1 evidence versions are \texttt{corrected-v2-full-2bff36fecd98fbb3} (P1/P2/P4) and \texttt{ACS2018-ftf1-p3-v1} (public ACS). The following are preserved validation results, not checks rerun during this writing pass.
after:
P1/P4 retain the source and evidence version \texttt{corrected-v2-full-2bff36fecd98fbb3}. P2/P3 are newly measured with implementation \texttt{FTF-1D-descriptor-v1}, in runs \texttt{ftf1d-p2-full-20260919} and \texttt{ftf1d-p3-full-20260919}. The numerical FTF-1 map, tabular inputs and \texttt{acs2018-ftf1-p3-v1} population, ordered identities, requests and seeds are unchanged.

The shared statistic accumulator now canonicalizes valid native-int64 array descriptors after the original validation and overflow checks. Pickle-restored arrays can have equivalent but different descriptor objects. Six predefined same-buffer checks on this runtime reproduce a roughly five- to six-fold change in the feature-sum reduction, reversible by restoring the alternate descriptor, without changing values, layout or precision. This is a local reduction measurement, not a full-algorithm speed factor or attribution of historical timings. All four methods use the same corrected path within existing timers; sampling, updates, certificates and fallback are unchanged. Historical timings remain a separate source/environment record.

Seventy focused old/new process comparisons and 1,350 saved full-grid checkpoint/method comparisons preserve exact numerical outputs; the latter also preserve P3 initializers and accounting. P1/P4 were not rerun. The following current numerical checks are distinct from reused historical stress and diagnostic evidence.

issue: P2 reductions and distinct E2E outcomes
before: Pooled elapsed reductions for direct/basic/runner-up are $-16.514\%,-24.403\%,-24.559\%$: negative means slower.
after: Pooled algorithm-time reductions for Direct/Basic/Runner-up are $5.730\%,0.567\%,0.492\%$. Their E2E total-time ratios are $1.049,0.996,0.995$, with wins in $170,69,70$ of 175 trials, respectively; there are no ties. Thus the certificates' small algorithm-time gains do not extend to total E2E time.
